question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. '**discrimination**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is that **Mahatma Gandhi was treated in an inferior way for his colour of skin in South Africa by a British officer.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is ‘*discrimination*'. 
 
• Discrimination means treating a person or particular group of people differently, especially in a worse way than the way in which you treat other people, because of their skin colour, sex, sexuality, etc.
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• *Dalits often face **discrimination **for being lower caste people in India.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

​

Correct Sentence:__ *When he suffered __**discrimination**__, he started the Civil Disobedience movement...*
